newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BBL sees 1997 profit growth of at least 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: BBL sees 1997 profit growth of at least 10 pct.

text.p: Michel Tilmant, chief executive officer of Banque Bruxelles Lambert (BBL), said on Wednesday that he expected 1997 profits to grow by at least 10 percent.

"It will be difficult to publish the same profit growth as in 1996, it will probably be a bit less than 15 percent, we should a least see profit growth of ten percent this year," Tilmant told a news conference.
BBL's 1996 earnings rose 15.1 percent to 10.29 billion francs.
"The first months of 1997 have been very good," Tilmant said.

But he added it was unlikely that the interest rate environment would be as favourable in 1997 as in 1996, when low short-term rates, falling bond yields and a steep yield curve provided ideal working conditions for banks.
